test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹360 in 3 years at 12% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹360

Time (T) = 3 years

Rate (R) = 12% per year

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

Where, P = Principal

**Calculation:**

360 = (P × 12 × 3) / 100

⇒ 360 = (P × 36) / 100

⇒ P = (360 × 100) / 36

⇒ P = ₹1000

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
